overall: All 13 VERIFIED probes matched their expect and currency strings, and all 4 BLOCKED rows are still refused. Generalisation worked for every constructible and index-anchored row except the Justia statute pattern: outside the CPLR it has a title level and no 's' prefix (gob/article-5/title-7/5-701/), so the written pattern misleads. Regex gaps: prose 'section N of the X Law', Tanbook acronyms (RPAPL, EPTL, BCL) and the Bluebook 'Fam. Ct. Act' all miss. 22 NYCRR matches both NYCRR regexes, so precedence must be specified. There is no abbreviation-to-LAWID alias list. Smaller fixes: the coa-500 probe should be the newer page (body now confirmed); the Justia case-page hazard should be revised (it does carry [*n] markers); the UCR Part list overstates coverage.
